% The table of contents' space above a chapter's entry, measured from a
% \l@chapter that, as tocloft's does, sets its page number in a \makebox,
% which starts a paragraph again.
\documentclass{report}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand*\l@chapter[2]{%
    \addpenalty{-\@highpenalty}\vskip 1em
    {\leavevmode\bfseries #1\hfil\makebox[\@pnumwidth][r]{#2}\par}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\chapter{A chapter}
\section{A section}
\end{document}
